title: T1 PYQ gate hardening + receipts + state ledger
hypothesis: If verify_pyqs matches windows with exact numbers/acronyms and requires receipts, then all attack mutants BLOCK while the real CN bank still PASSes

lessons.text: Windows: a lock file deleted on release is 'delete pending' for a moment and os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) then raises PermissionError, not FileExistsError; use a permanent lock file with msvcrt/fcntl byte locks

title: T2 ingest type sniffing + health gate
hypothesis: If ingest sniffs magic bytes, tolerates notes-less slides and exits 1 on errors, then ML/DMDW corpus coverage rises from 8/16 decks to 16/16 with 0 silent losses

lessons.text: Student-downloaded slide decks are often PDFs renamed .pptx/.ppt; always sniff magic bytes before choosing a parser

title: T3 coverage planner + pooled backtest
hypothesis: If score.py plans topic coverage under choice rules with pooled parameters, then the held-out 6h-plan mark coverage beats the old EV ranking and the uniform baseline on CN

lessons.text: On 3 CN papers the coverage planner beats the old P-ranking (6h cover 0.62 vs 0.30) but is not distinguishable from lecture-time-only (0.63) or random ideas (0.57); show bands, not percentages, until >=4 papers

title: T4 build/metrics hard gates, sty macros, phone edition
hypothesis: If build/metrics treat undefined refs, float-too-large, rc and stale PDFs as hard gates, then the CN trial guide (50 ??) fails metrics instead of reporting all clean

lessons.text: LLM reviewers and a log scan both missed 50 '??' in a shipped PDF; count LaTeX undefined references as a hard gate

title: T5 web export + flashcards
hypothesis: If each topic/PYQ becomes a phone-first page with SVG frame animations, then animations play in Chrome/mobile and every solved PYQ has an indexable page
ack_noise: new feature (DRAFT): no prior web export exists; metric is a guard, not a gain

title: P prompts for Round 4 interfaces
hypothesis: If the prompts describe the Round 4 interfaces with no contradictions, then a fresh-agent dry run plans the run with correct flags and no ambiguity

lessons.text: Prompt changes are validated only by a full from-scratch regeneration: the CN Round 4 run surfaced 8 tool bugs and 5 cross-writer convention conflicts that no unit test or dry run caught

title: flashcards.py marks the web folder it creates
hypothesis: If flashcards.py writes the .sgweb marker on a folder it creates, then web.py can rebuild after flashcards (Phase E order) while foreign folders stay protected

lessons.text: Tools that share an output folder need a shared ownership marker: flashcards.py created web/ without web.py's .sgweb marker, so Phase E's flashcards->web order failed only on real data; test the real stage order end to end

title: Q1 drill = newest 1-mark PYQ per idea
hypothesis: If the drill keeps only the newest one-mark PYQ per idea, ML's drill drops from 177 to a usable size while CN keeps one per idea

title: verify_pyqs: receipt-rescued questions use receipt positions in the duplicate check
hypothesis: If a question rescued by its receipt's fresh OCR is excluded from the corpus-position uniqueness check (its stray corpus positions are dropped) and checked instead against the paper's other questions by text and receipt rect, then CI MS2024B-1a/1b/1c and MS2025-1c pass while a real duplicate among rescued questions still blocks

lessons.text: When a gate falls back to a second evidence source (receipt fresh OCR), every downstream check must drop the state computed from the failed source (stray corpus positions) and use the fallback's own evidence; otherwise the fallback passes the text check but a later uniqueness check still reads the failed alignment.

title: receipts: region OCR reads pages scanned sideways
hypothesis: If receipts.py retries a low-match region OCR with the crop rotated 90/270/180 and keeps the best, then EE ES2023SP's rotated questions get a receipt match >= RECEIPT_MIN and upright crops

lessons.text: Scanned papers can be sideways (EE ES2023SP): when a region OCR reads below RECEIPT_MIN, retry the crop rotated 90/270/180 and store the receipt upright

title: verify: 'any two' over exactly two listed items inside one sub-part is that sub-part's choice
hypothesis: If check_marks treats a sub-part whose own text lists >= k items after 'any k' as a sub-part-level choice, then HPC ES2024 Q7 (7b: short notes on any two: (i),(ii)) passes verbatim while group-level 'any k' choices still block when a part is missing

lessons.text: check_marks: 'any k' followed by k of the sub-part's own (unbanked) item labels is that sub-part's wording, not a group choice; banked sub-part labels in the text still mean a group choice

title: receipts: rotate each part of a multi-page receipt on its own
hypothesis: If region_ocr picks the best rotation per part (pages of one scan can be turned opposite ways), then EE ES2023SP-2a (p2 rot90, p3 rot270) reaches RECEIPT_MIN

lessons.text: Pages of one scan can be turned opposite ways; a multi-page receipt needs a rotation per part

title: score: exam-hall plan and Q-structure use the current (newest, highest-weight) paper template
hypothesis: If exam_hall and the other templates[0] users take the highest-weight (newest) template, then DAA's plan says 10-mark optional questions as the current pattern does, not the oldest paper's 8

lessons.text: score.py templates come oldest-first; anything describing the current exam must use the highest-weight (newest) template, not templates[0]

title: One PDF per subject (one_pdf)
hypothesis: If assignments.json one_pdf=true folds pyq_older chapters into the guide and stops delivering the separate cheatsheet/archive, then each subject ships a single Guide PDF with all links local

lessons.text: one_pdf: merging the archive into the guide shifts TOC length and line breaks; expect 1-2 new overfulls per subject (unbreakable \src/\answer after a longer local \seesolved, multicols at a page end) and rebuild

title: Cover link: assignments.json updates_url
hypothesis: If build.py prints assignments.json updates_url as a clickable URL on the guide title page (validated, https only), then readers of a shared PDF can reach the latest version and a bad URL fails the build

lessons.text: Drive MCP create_file needs inline base64, so ~10 MB PDFs cannot be uploaded through it; create/share the folder via the connector and upload via browser or the user

title: layout_check replaces visual self-checks
hypothesis: If an automatic pymupdf layout check flags outside/overlap/on-line/tiny text, writers stop reading every contact sheet and image reads per writer fall while visual defects are still caught

lessons.text: Writers' context was dominated by images of their own renders (2,000 of 3,500 image reads, 2026-11 runs); an automatic pymupdf layout check that flags ~9% of pages replaces looking at every contact sheet. Calibrate such a checker on real output before trusting it: the first version flagged most phone pages (subscripts) and had ~2/12 precision; two calibration rounds raised it to ~7/8 on samples.

title: pack.py: one context file per writer
hypothesis: If each writer reads one capped pack (ids, targets, conventions, card, cited corpus pages only) instead of contract+JSONs+corpus, its starting context shrinks and fewer reads are needed, with the same assignment coverage

lessons.text: Real-data private check caught a cap bug the unit test missed: SE (75 topics, 640 cited pages) produced a 262 KB pack against a 150 KB cap because of a per-page floor; fixed by keeping each topic's first pages and listing the rest as ranges. Baseline 250 KB is an estimate of the contract+JSON+corpus reads, not a measurement.

title: metrics: internal_leaks gate + answers_vs_checks
hypothesis: If metrics gates convention ids printed in the PDF and tracks check-output vs boxed-answer mismatches, the leaks found in CN/SE/DAA and the 2052-vs-2051 class of error are caught before release

lessons.text: All 7 shipped endsem guides printed internal convention ids (2-26 each, 100 total), e.g. '(convention ack_number)': writers copy ids into prose. A PDF-text gate catches it; the writer card now forbids it. answers_vs_checks needed all output lines, thousands separators and LaTeX thin spaces before real CN gave 1/197 instead of 6/197 mismatches.

title: run_subject.py: one command per phase
hypothesis: If the main session runs deterministic phases through one script that updates the ledger and prints <=15 lines, main-session turns per subject and context growth drop

lessons.text: run_subject post on real CN: 282/519 pp rebuilt in 6.5 min with 15 output lines; it stopped at the new internal_leaks gate as intended. The key_lines filter (failing gates only) was added in the same edit as its test, so its RED was not observed.

title: answers_vs_checks: Indian grouping, printed precision, binary minus
hypothesis: If numbers are parsed with Indian digit grouping, compared at the answer's printed precision, and a minus after a symbol is not a sign, then the 6 real mismatches (CN 1, EE 3, HPC 2, all verified correct by hand) drop to 0 while the CN 2052 vs 2051 case still flags

lessons.text: answers_vs_checks must parse numbers the way the guides print them: Indian digit grouping (1,88,000), rounding to the printed decimals (half a unit of each side), and a minus right after a symbol (M+S-1) is binary. All 6 flags on the 2026-11-10 rebuild were checker false positives; a strict half-unit rule (no 0.1% relative slack) still flags 1.17 vs 1.1765.

title: verify_pyqs: '[alt k of N]' alternative pools are one choice slot
hypothesis: If check_marks treats all '<n> [alt k of N]' entries as one slot worth one alternative (equal marks, all N banked), then IPA ES2021SP (4/3/2-way alternatives, 188 banked marks vs 50) passes as 14 + 3 of 4 x 12 = 50 and unequal pools still fail, with every existing verify test unchanged

lessons.text: verify_pyqs must model every paper shape the subjects print (alt pools, printed gaps, sectioned choice, nested labels) and OCR look-alikes; add each as a check_marks/is_swap case, never a per-question exemption

title: print \answer: painless break before the box
hypothesis: If the print edition's \answer gets the phone edition's \hfil\penalty0\hfilneg break before its box, then no inline answer box runs into the margin (test_answer_break print 7 -> 0 overfull) and ML's 6 guide overfulls clear

lessons.text: An inline tcbox in justified text needs an explicit painless break before it, or TeX runs it into the margin instead of leaving a loose line

title: assign.py: lean writer split from blueprint + bank
hypothesis: If assignments.json is generated by a script (full/older papers, chapters, atoms, solve owners, notes-A/B split above 24 topics), then the main session stops hand-writing it and test_assign passes on a 28-topic synthetic subject

lessons.text: Generate assignments.json with assign.py; the main session only reviews its one-line summary

title: Writers on Sonnet (blind A/B) + review starts from writer doubts
hypothesis: If a Sonnet writer is rated equal or better than the main model in a blind pairwise review of one unit, writers can move to Sonnet at no quality loss; the reviewer reads writer_notes.md and unbacked numbers first
ack_noise: one unit, 6 pairs, one reviewer: small sample; re-run the A/B if Sonnet-written subjects score lower in review

lessons.text: Blind A/B (ML U7, 6 pairs): Sonnet writer 4, main model 1, tie 1, 3 small errors each; writers run on Sonnet

title: metrics: numbers_without_checks (tracked)
hypothesis: If metrics lists answer boxes printing a number with no backing check, unbacked numbers (e.g. ML A/B margins) become visible to the reviewer and fixer instead of silent

lessons.text: numbers_without_checks: map a box to its check by the nearest q:/iq: label or the atom stem; skip cheatsheet formulas and matching answers, or the metric drowns in noise (ML 36 -> 31 real)

title: pack.py: quote a shared page once, collapse whitespace, strip repeated headers
hypothesis: If shared corpus pages are quoted once and whitespace collapsed, packs shrink with every cited page tag kept

lessons.text: Pack dedupe saves only 1-5%: corpus pages are ~80% of a notes pack; a bigger cut needs quoting less of each page

title: Phone edition off by default (user, 2026-11-10)
hypothesis: If run_subject post builds the phone edition only with --phone and writers build print only, then no phone PDFs are produced and each post phase is ~9 min and each writer build pass about half shorter

title: lint_tex.py: pre-build lint for known LaTeX traps
hypothesis: If a 1-second lint catches answer-in-caption, duplicate newcommand, unbreakable words in fixed columns and banned [H]/tiny before the 5-minute guide build, writers fix them in context and post phases stop failing on them

title: web.py: collect chapter \newenvironment for standalone figure renders
hypothesis: If collect_defs also collects \newenvironment (guarded with \ifcsundef) and identical definitions are deduplicated, DMDW's 3 olbox figure renders succeed

lessons.text: A render cache must key failures on every input that can fix them (here the collected chapter definitions), or a fixed bug keeps failing from cache
